ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) fluke surface against high-intensity (white/grey) water background and spray; fluke itself shows low internal contrast due to shadows.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude notches on the distal 20% of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the superior edges of both lobes extending from notch to tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical irregularity and loss of smooth contour on the far-left distal lobe tip compared to the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity pixel clusters (water spray/splash) obscuring the proximal inferior margins of the fluke surface.
